Farmer: Use case: style-transfer. Repaint image 1 (the 3D model) as one polished illustrated 2D Roblox monster collection icon. Image 1 controls exact creature, attire, open mouth, proportions and three-quarter pose. Image 2 shows only the existing game's illustration style: clean dark plum outline, bold hand-shaped colourful cel shading, decisive glossy highlight shapes, simple large colour masses, confident ink silhouette. This creature is the Blind Crawler: a low, hulking, bald EYELESS quadruped with a rounded domed forehead joined directly to a wide toothy mouth, stout hump, long muscular front arms planted wide and bent shorter hind legs. Its upper face is entirely unbroken dark mottled charcoal hide. Absolutely no eyes, eyeholes, nose, ears, nostrils, horns, long snout, tail or humanoid chest. Keep the monster menacing. Preserve the mottling as a few strong charcoal/grey patches. Match its exact costume. Full character on a square transparent canvas with generous clear margin around every claw and bit of gear. Near front three-quarter view, head towards left. All four paws on the same level, no handheld objects. No scenery, shadow on the ground, pedestal, frame, lettering or badges. Outfit: Wide ochre straw hat, red band, small wheat sprig, olive work coat, brown seed pouch, tan cuffs.
